Done. Comments only — the diff against a pre-edit backup confirms **zero code lines changed** in either file.

## Important: 3 of the 8 sites were already compliant

Before editing I checked each cast **by content** and against `git show sfcc-89-wip:...`. The scorer's read was stale for three sites — the markers were already present, in `sfcc-89-wip` too:

| Scorer's claim | Actual state found |
|---|---|
| `:227` carries no marker | Marker present at `:225`, canonical form. **No change made.** |
| `:341` carries no marker | Marker present at `:339`, canonical form. **No change made.** |
| `:184` carries no marker | Marker present, but used `SDK param widening**:**` instead of the canonical `SDK param widening **—**` at `:257`. Normalised the punctuation only. |

## I probed each cast rather than guessing why it exists

I removed each cast, ran `tsc`, and restored from checksum-verified backups. I also ran a deliberate-failure mutation (`width: ((): number => 'definitely-not-a-number')()` → `TS2322` at the exact line) to prove tsc actually checks these files, so a clean result is meaningful rather than a file-not-included artifact.

**Three of the casts turned out to be inert** — they suppress nothing:

- **`product-view:594-596` (the `cloneElement` trio)** — removing all three: `tsc` clean, lint unchanged at 17/16. `customButton.props` is `any` (`React.ReactElement` defaults `P = any`), and `Partial<unknown>` is `{}`.
- **`product-detail:756` (`as unknown as React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>`)** — removing it: `tsc` clean. TypeScript accepts the `this`-typed callback as a ref on its own. `ChildProductRef['ref']` is `HTMLDivElement | null`, a real type, so this is genuine structural compatibility, not an `any` artifact.

  This mattered: the existing comment asserted *"The assertion is unavoidable"* — **factually false**. Leaving it would have been worse than no comment, so I corrected it. Line 735 (`// Do not use an arrow function…`) is base's own and is untouched.

**One cast is load-bearing but was mis-categorised in the brief.** `product-detail:431` was assigned to group B ("add the SDK marker"). It is **not** an SDK-parameter cast: `pickupInStoreMap` is this page's own `useState<Record<string, boolean>>`. Removing the cast gives `TS2538: Type 'undefined' cannot be used as an index type`. Applying the "SDK param widening" marker there would have made the `:98-104` block *less* accurate — repeating the exact defect being fixed. I wrote an accurate comment that explicitly says it is *not* one of those casts, so a reader following the marker convention isn't misled.

## Final line numbers

| Site | Final | What landed |
|---|---|---|
| A | `product-detail/index.tsx:756` | Comment rewritten at `:742-747` — corrects the false "unavoidable" claim; records the `this`/`Ref<T>` contract and that the cast is verified inert |
| A | `product-view/index.tsx:594-596` | **One** comment at `:585-591` |
| B | `product-detail/index.tsx:184` | Marker at `:181`, punctuation normalised to `—` |
| B | `product-detail/index.tsx:227` | Already compliant (`:225`) — no change |
| B | `product-detail/index.tsx:341` | Already compliant (`:339`) — no change |
| B | `product-detail/index.tsx:431` | New comment at `:425-430` |

**One comment, not three, for `:594-596`.** The three casts share one cause (all inert, all on one `cloneElement` expression) and one proof (one tsc run covering all three). Three comments would have repeated the same finding and buried the one genuinely non-obvious part — that `Partial<unknown>` is `{}` — in the third of them.

## Gates — all unchanged

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| G1 `npx tsc --noEmit` | **0 errors** |
| G2 `npx vitest run` | **354 tests / 22 files**, all passed |
| G3 `npm run lint` | **17 errors, 16 warnings** |
| G5 `npm run audit:tokens` | **14 unacknowledged, 21 acknowledged** |

G5's `product-view` anchors survived the `+7` shift: `:722`, `:723`, `:724`, `:776`, `:835` all still list as acknowledged.

## Confirmations

- `:281`, `:290` and the `as Error` (now `:492`, shifted `+6` by the `:425` insertion) are **untouched** — verified in the diff and by reading them back.
- `product-view`'s header from `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md, the default export stays a faithful...` onward is **byte-intact**; the only product-view change is the insertion at `:585`.
- No git ref touched — no commit, stage, stash, or checkout. Still `AM`/`AM` on `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info`.

## Noticed, not fixed (all code changes — out of scope for a comments-only pass)

1. **Three inert casts should probably just be deleted** rather than documented: `product-view:594-596` and `product-detail:756`. `typescript.md` says reach for `as` "only when you're genuinely overriding what TypeScript can infer" — these override nothing. Deleting them is provably safe (tsc clean, lint unchanged) and would beat any comment. I documented them instead because this pass forbids code changes; worth a follow-up decision.
2. **`product-detail:257`'s marker block at `:98-104` doesn't cover every cast in the file** even after this pass. `:184`, `:227`, `:257`, `:341`, `:645` are genuine SDK-param casts; `:281`/`:290`/`:492` are error-narrowing; `:431` is an index cast; `:756` is a ref cast. The block reads as though it describes all of them. Rewording it to say it covers *one category* would close the remaining gap — but that's the developer's call, and the out-of-scope sites are involved.
